_doc: North Haven Private Income Fund LLC (Morgan Stanley) anchor dialect (agentA induced, sandboxed, 2026-06-20). Regime: flattened-concatenation, NO reliable delimiter. Goal: give recoverable structure to the dominant rate-bearing variant and the equity rows WITHOUT fragmenting the dominant variant, and recognize this filer's section markers. The dominant variant (2880 rows, 35.8%) is phrased: 'Investments-non-controlled/non-affiliated Debt Investments <Industry> <Issuer> Investment First Lien Debt Reference Rate and Spread S + 7.00% (incl. 5.00% PIK) Interest Rate 11% Maturity Date 07/29/2029'. Its existing signature 'AFFIL REFRATE RATE MAT' is already non-empty; the additions below keep it intact (DEBT marker co-occurs but does not split it; REFRATE/RATE/MAT reused).
_doc2: AFFIL: matches the Morgan Stanley affiliation header forms 'Investments-non-controlled/non-affiliated', 'non-controlled/affiliated', and the bare 'Investments ...' (controlled) header seen in the 'MAT'-signature variant where the affiliation prefix is dropped. The hyphenated 'Investments-non-controlled/non-affiliated' form is the key per-CIK marker. DEBT: 'First Lien Debt' / 'Second Lien Debt' / 'Debt Investments' instrument language; co-occurs on the dominant rate rows so it adds a signature signal without fragmenting (REFRATE+RATE+MAT already dominate the rate-bearing variant). EQUITY: 'Common Equity' / 'Preferred Equity' language on the equity-investment rows (signature 'AFFIL EQUITY MAT' / 'MAT'), which never carry a reference rate, so the EQUITY anchor cannot leak onto the floating debt variant. REFRATE catches 'Reference Rate and Spread' plus the bare 'S +' / SOFR words. RATE catches the percent tokens. MAT catches m/d/yyyy dates (both Maturity Date and Acquisition Date fold into MAT via the date regex, intentionally not separated).
_doc3: HONESTY: 62% of rows land in (none). The none_examples ('Associations, Inc. 1', 'Kaseya, Inc. 2', 'Lightspeed Solution, LLC 1') are bare 'Issuer, Inc. N' tranche fragments with NO category/instrument/rate/date token at all. No anchor can recover structure that is not in the string. The anchors below intentionally do NOT add an issuer-name catch-all to force the none-share down on these rows -- that would fabricate a signature with zero extractable content. The recoverable share is the structured AFFIL/DEBT/EQUITY/REFRATE/RATE/MAT rows; the bare tranche fragments are irreducibly sparse (mirrors MidCap's sparse residual).

anchors.label: CASH
anchors.regex: money market|government fund|financial square|u\.?s\.? government|liquidity (?:fund|funds)|cash and cash equivalent

anchors.label: DEBT
anchors.regex: first lien debt|second lien debt|senior secured|subordinated debt|debt investments?|unsecured debt

anchors.label: EQUITY
anchors.regex: common equity|preferred equity|equity interest|membership interest|preferred stock|common stock|warrant|equity investments?
